annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive to clients about the level of trust to be placed in HTTPS RRs received over an insecure channel. It draws a direct comparison to a 307 redirect over cleartext HTTP, which is a well-defined HTTP behavior. There is no ambiguity in the language or in the expected implementation behavior.
